kurz: AMW can handle two things for you: how strictly a change is reviewed (review level) and when it reports that something can be released (release rhythm). Both stay off until the lead switches them on.

schritte.text: Settings › Project › Review levels to “on”. From then on every review request starts with its level and the files that decide it.

High – everything with permission or security checks: database, sign-in, command line, online actions, service, file exchange, queue, release, PHP of the online page – is reviewed by the lead. Medium – interface, help and other code – by an agent other than the builder. Low – docs and tests only – needs no review request.
With the lead's merge approval and a green full run on exactly this commit: `amw release ausliefern --zweig <branch> --aufgabe <nr>`.

The builder can raise a review request: `amw pruefung bitte … --stufe hoch`. Lowering is not possible. If the version commit changes more than CHANGELOG, the version file and `web/inc/VERSION`, the review request already says so, and a full run only starts there with `--trotzdem "reason"`.

Settings › Project › Release rhythm: immediately, daily at a time, or per milestone. When something is ready – green review, merge approval, full run on exactly this commit – whoever handles merges (otherwise the lead) gets one message. AMW never releases by itself.

After `amw release ausliefern`, every task whose green commit with merge approval is included counts as done – the reviewed commit is the evidence. Give the sentence for the release notes right in the review request: `amw pruefung bitte … --aufgabe <no> --gruppe neu --hinweis "…"`. If you leave it out, AMW works out the group and the sentence itself when the task is closed (from the commit, the topic or the title); the release notes draft shows it as a suggestion. Open criteria do not block this; the lead is told about them. A task waiting for the developer (for example a confirmation on the device) stays open. Projects that merge through GitHub pull requests: when the title of a merged PR starts with the task (“A1234: …”, “[A1234] …”) or its text says “fertig: A1234” or “closes A1234”, and its checks are green, the task is set to done as well (evidence = merge commit). Merely mentioning a task (“groundwork for A1235”) does not count. AMW asks with `gh` in the project folder – only when there is a reason (merge approval, delivery, end of a run with a task, a “merged” message), otherwise at most once an hour and only while there are open tasks with a branch – only if the operating mode allows the connection (github.com only in “Cloud”); `gh` keeps its own sign-in. To switch it off: Settings › Project › Automatic planning.

`amw release ausliefern` updates AMW on the PC (and AMW online), but pushes nothing and creates no GitHub release. When a milestone is done, it appears under “For you” with “Accept”. When you accept it (on the PC or `amw bogen abnehmen <no>`), AMW publishes all versions since the last publication once – with one GitHub release. As before on every delivery: setting `veroeffentlichen=sofort`.

werte: off, immediately, daily at HH:MM, per milestone
fehler: After rebasing, everything is open again

No longer: if only the base changed (same content, new commit), `amw release ausliefern` takes over the green review and the merge approval itself and records the source – for a stack of several tasks on one state, for each task. An exception from the full test run set by the lead stays valid as long as the content (tree) is the same. If the content changed, a new review is needed. If something is missing, the chain lists all missing approvals in one message.
“Der Stand ändert Sichtbares … – Prüfbitte nur mit Bild”

The commit changes the page or the help, but no image is attached to the task. File one from the PC and the phone (390 px): `amw dokument ablegen bild.png --art bild --aufgabe <no> --titel …`; the review request then names it by itself. Exception only with `--ohne-bild <reason>`.
“Version 1.2.0 ist schon vergeben” on a review request

Another task already carries this number (open or green review not yet released), it is not above main, or the tag exists. The message names the next free number; change it in the commit and submit again. A branch without its own version (the same as where it branched off main) is not checked – only the stack gets the number.
The review request went to an agent, the level requires the lead. Ask the lead instead.
AMW could not read the changed files: the project folder is missing or the commit is unknown there. It then counts as high.
It only reports once every open task of the milestone is ready.
